[[File:Sentry_Droid-D7.png|thumb|right|250px|Sentry droid]]
'''Sentry droids''' or '''patrol droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that acted as sentries in various locations. Small, wheeled sentry droids patrolled the corridors of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Other versions patrolled bases like the one on [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. The [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie|Starhunters]] used patrol droids to guard the cages of the precious animals they kept on the planet [[Dandelo]].<ref name="Coby and the Starhunters">{{DroidsCite|Coby and the Starhunters}}.</ref> [[Mark IV sentry droid/Legends|Mark IV sentry droids]] were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to scout and surveil areas on planets such as the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="IV SE">{{Film|IV}} {{C|[[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]]}}</ref>
